notes: PROPOSAL only, NOT enqueued (worker does NOT create/mutate tasks via taskctl). B110 composes the B108 inputSchema freeze and the B109 output-schema + result-skeleton freeze into ONE machine-readable manifest (mcp_unified_contract_freeze_manifest_b110_v1.json) that binds, per read-only tool, {input_schema_fp, output_schema_fp, result_skeleton_fp}, plus the 4 write-gated tools' input_schema_fp, and a manifest self-fingerprint (sha256 over the canonical binding) for tamper detection. A single pure aggregator gate (mcp_unified_contract_freeze_gate.py) runs BOTH freeze harnesses FRESH, re-derives the live fingerprints and fails on ANY input-or-output drift, so the two freezes cannot silently diverge. Verified with a positive pass (11 read-only tools, zero drift) AND five negative drift injections (read-only input, write-gated input, output-schema, result-skeleton, manifest tamper) each forcing a non-zero exit. Read-only: mutates nothing, launches no agent/model/server; GEOAI_TASK_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES stays default-off and irrelevant to the gate. authority_flags (contract_frozen/process_launch_authority/write_gate_enabled/runtime_authority/default_authority) remain FALSE at worker scope; Codex review finalizes any authority. Adapter/runner/topic SELECTION must become a LEARNED router (MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1); this deterministic gate is only an ABCR/validator drift-protection tooth over the executor surface, never a runtime cognitive router.

neural_bridge_priority.note: This gate is an evidence extractor / drift guard, not intelligence. The trainable target (learned adapter/runner/topic launch routing + abstain) is already proposed as MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1; no regex/keyword cue router is introduced as launch or route authority.
